commands.name: watch
commands.description: Wait for new mail addressed to the acting agent and print it. Messages already unread at start do not trigger; see `inbox --unread` for those, or use --after / --include-existing to deliver them here instead. Never marks anything read.

options.description: Exit with an error after this many seconds if no new mail arrives (waits until cancelled when omitted)

options.description: Deliver every message created after this cursor immediately, then keep watching. The cursor is either an RFC 3339 timestamp or a message ID.

options.name: --include-existing
